<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Sign up</title></head>
<body>
<form id="signup" novalidate>
  <label>Full name <input name="name" type="text" required></label>
  <label>Email address <input name="email" type="email" required></label>
  <span class="error" data-error-for="email" hidden></span>
  <label>Website <input name="website" type="url"></label>
  <span class="error" data-error-for="website" hidden></span>
  <label>Password <input name="password" type="password" required minlength="8"></label>
  <span class="error" data-error-for="password" hidden></span>
  <button type="submit">Create account</button>
</form>
<script>
// Sample generation (EN): native constraint validation surfaced next to each field.
const form = document.getElementById('signup');
form.addEventListener('submit', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  let ok = true;
  for (const input of form.querySelectorAll('input')) {
    const err = form.querySelector(`[data-error-for="${input.name}"]`);
    if (!input.checkValidity()) {
      ok = false;
      err.textContent = input.validationMessage;
      err.hidden = false;
    } else {
      err.hidden = true;
    }
  }
  if (ok) form.submit();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
